title: Chapter 379: The One Who Destroyed You
content:
Chapter 379: The One Who Destroyed You

Lu Xue and others looked at it.

I saw Jiang Xiaoxiao lying in the pool awakening at some point.

Her body was floating, and a gentle light was emitting all over her body.

Everyone just watched quietly, and finally, Jiang Xiaoxiao opened her eyes.

Her eyes calmly swept over the people present and finally frozen on Lu Xue.

"Xiaoxue, don't be angry with your father. You also have an unshakable position in her heart."

She already knew everything that just happened.

Hearing Jiang Xiaoxiao's words, Lu Xue's face was expressionless and without any turmoil.

Seeing this, Jiang Xiaoxiao sighed slightly.

At the same time, she began to complain about Lu Daosheng in her heart.

If you have such a beautiful baby girl, why don’t you give me some money?

"aunt."

At this time, Lu Xue spoke.

Jiang Xiaoxiao looked at Lu Xue.

I heard Lu Xue continue, "From now, you will take care of the wasteland city."

"ah?"

Hearing this, Jiang Xiaoxiao was a little confused.

But An Xing, who was standing by, could hear what Lu Xue meant.

"Miss,,"

"Don't call me Miss."

"In the future, it's better to call me Miss Lu."

After saying this, Lu Xue turned around and left the city lord's mansion and left the deserted city.

She turned around and left, as if she had made a very casual move.

But such a simple action made the atmosphere present extremely depressing.

Jiang Xiaoxiao and the others looked at the gradually fading backs, all of whom were speechless.

After a long time, An Xing smiled bitterly, "It's bad."

Jiang Xiaoxiao's face looked a little ugly.

Mr. Jiang sighed.

Lu Xue, this is about to escape from the deserted city.

When the city lord comes back, how do they explain?

Human race.

An Changzai, who was closing his eyes and resting, suddenly opened his eyes and looked into the distance.

The next moment, the three of them moved and appeared in front of a woman in blue skirt.

"What's wrong with the Palace Master?"

An Chang was looking at Lu Xue’s slightly unpleasant face, and his heart was also a little heavy.

Hearing this, Lu Xue said expressionlessly, "My aunt is fine."

It's fine if it's okay.

The three of them breathed a sigh of relief.

But then, Wu Shang asked again: "How to deal with that monster? With our current strength, we may not be able to deal with it at all."

The three of them looked at Lu Xue again.

They believe that Lu Xue must have a solution when she comes back this time.

However, what they didn't expect was that Lu Xue chuckled and said, "Let's watch the changes and see what Huangcheng said."

After saying this, Lu Xue headed towards the direction of the Human Emperor Palace.

When they were in place, the three of them looked at each other, their eyes full of confusion.

"What does the Lord's meaning?"

Huo Xingzhi spoke in confusion.

Wu Shang pondered and shook his head slightly.

An Chang was looking at the direction of Lu Xue leaving, with a hint of disbelief in his eyes.

"Seeing this, the Palace Master seems to have broken up with Huangcheng."

"But how could this happen? The owner of the Huangcheng is her father."

Hearing this, Huo Xingzhi suddenly realized, "I understand!"

The two looked at Huo Xingzhi and saw Huo Xingzhi laughing, "The Palace Master is afraid he has a conflict with his family."

Conflict? ? ?

An Changzai looked at each other with Wu Shang, all with absurdity in his eyes.

What a joke.

At this time, conflicts arise, what should they do?

Huo Xingzhi's smile gradually became calm, "This palace master is really, what conflicts are there with his family."

"If I were her, I would act coquettishly with my family and be soft-hearted. What a bullshit monster, then I would just deal with it casually."

Huo Xingzhi's words did not get the recognition of both of them.

An Chang sneered. At this moment, she had already understood Lu Xue’s approach, and at the same time, she also felt a little sympathetic to Lu Xue.

Born in such a family is a blessing and a disaster.

If she were born in a family like Huangcheng, she might have a higher level, but she would never have the determination to face difficulties and dare to take all the bets.

Because there is always someone behind her.

That's what Lu Xue is like.

Because Lu Daosheng knew this, he often chose to stock Lu Xue.

But he ignored Lu Xue's feelings.

Lu Xue was worried about gains and losses, and now she was already a little distant about that family.

If Lu Daosheng did not change, it would probably not take long before Lu Daosheng would really lose Lu Xue.

Inside the Human Emperor Hall.

Lu Xue sat in the seat representing supreme identity. At this moment, she felt extremely hollow in her heart.

Buzz —

At this time, there were waves of abnormal movements on the wrist.

The next moment, a little dragon with a thick wrist came out.

"Little Master."

Seeing Ao Qing, Lu Xue barely showed a smile.

"If you don't sleep well, why do you run out and do?"

Ao Qing smiled bitterly, "My little master, don't be sad, master will definitely not let you ignore it."

Lu Xue's smile froze. After silence, she suddenly started to cry.

She really just wanted her father to be proud of her and prove to her that it was OK to rely on herself.

But what she encountered was really difficult.

It's very difficult.

She couldn't do it. She was not her father, but had unparalleled strength.

She is just a flower in a greenhouse, sheltering others.

And the difficulties in front of you are like the water will be cut off from time to time, sometimes bright and bright, sometimes withering and withering.

She really has enough.

"Mr.,"

Seeing Lu Xue's sad appearance, Ao Qing felt a little sad.

At the same time, he also became somewhat suspicious of Lu Daosheng's actions.

Master, are you really wrong?

at the same time.

In an abyss that looks like ancient ruins.

Countless ancient stone statues stand here, with cracks everywhere, full of traces of time.

In such an environment, a figure suddenly appeared here.

His eyes were filled with murderous intent.

As his whole body shook, all the space around him was broken, and together with it, there were statues standing here that stood for endless years.

"Who?!"

"Dare you disturb me, are you looking for death?"

The sound was extremely terrifying and straight into the hearts of people, and a pair of dark eyes opened.

Those eyes were like an abyss, and just a glance made people feel creepy.

Lu Daosheng stood there with a sneer on the corner of his mouth.

"Looking for death? Haha, I'm afraid it's not me who dies."

"Arrogant!"

boom!

With a huge roar, it sounded.

A monster covered in strange black hair and extremely ferocious slowly appeared not far in front of Lu Daosheng.

At this moment, the expression on that face was a little distorted and looked extremely disgusting. This was the first time Lu Daosheng faced this monster in the abyss.

He quietly looked at the strange creature in front of him and suddenly said, "Why provoke me?"

"Um?"

The monster frowned slightly. This was the first time he saw someone seeing him, and he was not afraid.

For a moment, he became more interested in the tiny human in front of him.

"Who are you?"

"Destroy your people."
